chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ali ibn Asbaat, from Ali ibn Abu Hamza, from Abi Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
And they followed what the devils chanted, with the Wilayah (guardianship) of the devils over the reign of Solomon,
And he also recited: 'Ask the Children of Israel how many clear signs We have given them,'
Among them were those who believed, and among them were those who denied, and among them were those who confessed, and among them were those who altered.
And whoever changes the favor of Allah after it has come to him, then surely Allah is severe in retribution.

key_terms.وَلَايَةِ الشَّيَاطِينِ: Wilayah of the devils (spiritual authority/guidance of the devils)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'what the devils chanted' in relation to Solomon's reign and the Children of Israel?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elucidates the phrase 'what the devils chanted' in Surah Al-Baqarah by identifying it as the devils' claim to spiritual authority (Wilayah) during Solomon’s reign, a concept central to Shia exegesis of the 'false prophets' among the Children of Israel. The Imam further recites verses detailing the varied responses of the Israelites to divine signs—belief, denial, confession, or alteration—culminating in the warning that Allah is severe in retribution for those who distort His favor. This highlights the theological theme of *Tahreef* (alteration) and the distinction between true and false divine authority.

en.hubeali: H 14888 – Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Baseer, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws said:
“[2:102] And they followed what the Shaitans chanted of sorcery (with the Wilayah of the Satans) in the reign of Sulaiman”.
And heasws also recited “[2:211] Ask the Israelites how many a clear sign have We given them;
(and among them were ones who believed, and among them were ones who fought against there, and among them were ones who accepted, and among them were ones who altered them)
and whoever changes the favour of Allah after it has come to him, then surely Allah is severe in requiting (evil).”[31]
